scope: Proposition 4 (Unit-nucleus replacement) of the manuscript “QMA-hardness of continuum Coulomb energy with unit nuclear charges” (preprints/QMA-hardness-of-continuum-Coulomb-energy-with-unit-nuclear-charges-September-24-2026/QMA-hardness-of-continuum-Coulomb-energy-with-unit-nuclear-charges-September-24-2026.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 275 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 d817c071169eb58c), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 15. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For the transported degree-three cubature and rational rounding just specified, with δR ≤ (1 + H)−3(1 + S)−2λ−3, the shifted continuous and point-nucleus operators Lc, Lp satisfy |⟨u, (Lp − Lc)u⟩| ≤ p(n, D)λ−2/3 (∥u∥2 + ∥∇u∥2 ), ∥P(Lp − Lc)P∥P ≤ p(n, D)λ−4/3 . (7) The first estimate holds for every one-particle H1 function u. The second is the norm of the compressed form on the localized-mode space Ran P. Both bounds are in dilated energy units.
